title: Timeless Airport

physical_identity: A timeless infinite airport complex: baggage claim, endless check-in, non-Euclidean concourses, shops, travelators, 26 terminals A-Z with infinite gates.
scale_topology: Infinite horizontally in the entry zones; remainder a non-Euclidean maze; only known boundary is the baggage-claim wall.
anomalies: Severe time dilation (1 week = 1 second in Level 11)
lighting_sound: Constant machine hum and metal creaking at baggage claim; PA announcements; flickering light distortion; lounges; Wi-Fi.
